about: Agent Mandate §8, the treasury: the draw record a settlement from it leaves (§8.4, proposed for 0.9.0-draft), the rule every draw passes (§8.2), and the sums over the records (§8.3).

Draw records are signed by the settling platform under agent-mandate-draw-v1, in canonical padded base64. The platform's key is a test key derived from the label below, as every key in these files is: its Ed25519 seed is the SHA-256 of the label.
The rule cases give the mandate as it stood at approval, the request, and the rule that refuses, or ok. Amounts are in the settling platform's integer unit.

platform_key.label: Agent Mandate conformance test key: settling-platform

identifiers.name: the same transaction under another organization

signatures.name: a draw, signed by the platform
a reversal, signed by the platform
signed by a key that is not the platform's
signatures.why: §8.3: the platform's signature attributes the line; any other key's, however well it verifies, does not.

signatures.name: the signature in base64url
signatures.why: A draw record's signature is canonical padded base64.

signatures.name: a second signature that does not verify
signatures.why: Every signature on a record verifies, or the record is refused.

shapes.name: a draw
shapes.why: §8.3: the engagement, the mandate, the holder, the amount and the time.

shapes.name: a reversal
shapes.why: A refund is a record of its own; nothing is edited.

shapes.name: a member this version does not define
an id its transaction does not derive
a reversal that names no draw
shapes.why: A reversal names the draw it undoes.

shapes.name: a draw that names a record it undoes
an amount of zero
shapes.why: A draw moves a positive whole number.

shapes.name: a negative amount
shapes.why: Value coming back is a reversal, not a negative draw.

shapes.name: a failed settlement
shapes.why: A settlement that failed moved nothing and leaves no record.

shapes.name: no engagement version
shapes.why: The agreed version it settled under.

shapes.name: a mandate id of the wrong form
no holder account
shapes.why: Every line is attributed to a person's authority.

shapes.name: a signature in another role
shapes.why: The settling platform signs the record.

may_draw.name: within the mandate
may_draw.why: §8.2: approved under a mandate in force that names the organization as payer, within its ceilings.

may_draw.name: a mandate whose holder pays
may_draw.why: §6 rule 6: only a mandate naming the organization as payer draws on the treasury.

may_draw.name: a mandate with no settlement clause
another organization's treasury
may_draw.why: §8.1: the treasury is the organization's own.

may_draw.name: approved by an account that does not hold the mandate
may_draw.why: §8.3: the draw is attributed to the holder whose authority it was made under.

may_draw.name: approved at the instant the mandate expired
in another currency
may_draw.why: A ceiling in one currency is not compared with an amount in another.

may_draw.name: one unit past per_engagement
may_draw.why: The engagement's draws, this one included, stay within per_engagement.

may_draw.name: an amount of zero
may_draw.why: A draw is a positive whole number.

month_to_date.name: the calendar month in UTC, draws only, this holder only
month_to_date.why: §8.3: the month-to-date sums are computed over the draw records. The first instant of the month counts and the first of the next does not; a reversal does not un-commit; another holder's and another organization's draws are theirs.

books.name: a draw, its partial reversal, and three that do not match
books.why: §8.3: the treasury's history is the sum of its records. A draw is reversed at most once, by no more than it drew; another organization's record is not in these books. Records the books cannot explain are listed, never summed.
